name: Trance_OCE
summary: Destiny 2 speedrunner. He suggests testing whether zoop distance depends on FPS, gaining height to zoop past the Keep jumping puzzle, and starting in Leggings of Lightness then hot-swapping instead of learning the plunge tech. He "guarantee[s]" sub 5.

insights.text:
I would also look at gaining verticality at 4:10 in this room and zooping to skip the jumping puzzle. I feel like movement tech can be incorporated here.

Would also do some experimenting to see if zooping and distance is tied to FPS (is the case on the tiger engine /destiny 2 and worldlining)
If you don't want to learn the tech you can easily start with Leggings of Lightness to achieve the height and hotswap to another armor piece when waiting for something and lose no ticks.
insights.verification_note: Untested. Rules: the armor swap is a normal game action.

insights.text: ​ @iNanobit I'll do some theory crafting and try stuff out when I return from vacation in 2 weeks. I've been gone for 6 weeks and have missed the launch of this expansion, but eager to run this. A heap of similarities between destiny 2 speeds and this run, especially with oobs. While not obvious right now I guarantee you sub 5 is possible

Dragonwilds devs over patch to the point it will only hurt the game 

They clearly don't want dedicated players, endgame and Speedrunning 💀
